description: This Java source file defines the 'NewEventForwarder' class, an Akka actor that forwards 'ThingEvent' messages for inactive shard regions, manages subscriptions, and schedules periodic sharding state updates.

classes.name: NewEventForwarder
classes.description: An Akka actor that forwards 'ThingEvent' messages for inactive shard regions, manages subscriptions, and schedules periodic sharding state updates.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for the NewEventForwarder actor with specified dependencies.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling behavior for the actor, including processing 'ThingEvent', rebalancing, and handling unknown messages.

methods.name: retrieveClusterShardingStats
methods.description: Requests current cluster sharding statistics from the shard region.

methods.name: updateSubscriptions
methods.description: Updates subscriptions based on inactive shard IDs, subscribing to new ones and unsubscribing from old ones.

methods.name: processThingEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming 'ThingEvent' messages, logs, and forwards them after blocking namespaces.

methods.name: getActiveShardIds
methods.description: Extracts active shard IDs from sharding statistics.
